_doc: Knobs for the autonomy system (docs/process/AUTONOMY.md §11). Read at run time from the DEFAULT branch by board.yml / techlead.yml / worker.yml / automerge.yml / claude-review.yml and by tools/dev/techlead.py; missing keys fall back to the DEFAULTS in that file. Change via a normal PR (bots may merge it). Emergency pause without a PR: put the label `bots-paused` on the board issue (planner + worker stop; reviews and merges continue).
